description:
SingleCell-Unseen-Benchmark
	


	
		
		Overview
	

SingleCell-Unseen-Benchmark is a large-scale unseen single-cell transcriptomic benchmark designed to systematically evaluate foundation models on cell identification and cell type tracing tasks.The benchmark covers tumor, stem, neural, and normal cell populations, with a particular emphasis on unseen data distributions, including rare cell types, cross-dataset generalization, and heterogeneous tumor states.
In addition to curated… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/SiatBioInf/SingleCell-Unseen-Benchmark.
evaluation_method: F1 and accuracy for classification tasks; clustering metrics (e.g., ARI) for tracing/unsupervised evaluation; OOD/generalization measures for unseen distributions
reputation: A specialized benchmark hosted on Hugging Face for evaluating foundation models on challenging single-cell generalization tasks; adoption is growing within computational biology/modeling groups but remains domain-specific.
